judge.rationale: The candidate did not implement any production code at all. Its diff only adds a `.lore/dod.md` planning file, an acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and brief edits to the two spec files. None of `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, or `CHANGELOG.md` were touched. Moreover, the newly added acceptance test contains a bug (`expect(result.valid && result.error).toMatch(...)` evaluates to `false` when `result.valid` is `false`) and will fail immediately because none of the tested functionality exists.
